annotations.title: Recompute a verdict hash without trusting the issuer

description: Take a verdict this gate issued and recompute its record_sha256 independently. Removes record_sha256 and recompute_note, serialises the remainder in key order, and hashes it. Returns whether the verdict was altered after it was issued. You do not have to trust the party that issued the verdict, including this one.

record.description: The full verdict object as returned by check_conformance or GET /self

name: verify_verdict

verified.description: true = the verdict hashes to its own record_sha256, so it was not altered after issue. false = it was altered. This is a finding about the record, not an error.

title: Recompute a verdict hash without trusting the issuer
